Bulbous_Periscopic_Eyes.description: These bulbous, periscopic eyes are adapted for both aquatic and amphibious environments, granting enhanced perception and stealth capabilities, allowing their owners to see through murky waters and blend into shadows with eerie precision.

Horizontal_Slit_Pupils.description: Emerging from the murky depths of the swamp, the Horizontal_Slit_Pupils gleam with an unsettling intelligence, their toad-like eyes piercing through the veil of darkness, granting enhanced perception and wisdom to those who bear them.

Vertical_Slit_Pupils.description: Vertical slit pupils, a hauntingly elegant adaptation of nocturnal amphibians, enhance both accuracy and perception in the darkest of environments, granting the wielder an unsettling yet advantageous vision that pierces through the veil of night.

Heart_Shaped_Pupils.description: The Heart-Shaped Pupils, a unique trait of the Bombina amphibian, endow its wielder with a heightened sense of awareness and agility, enhancing evasion by one tier, as if the very shape of the eyes bestows a mystical allure that distracts foes and grants moments of stealthy grace.

Nictitating_Membrane_Goggles.description: Woven from the resilient, translucent membranes of ancient amphibian creatures, these goggles provide a second layer of protection and clarity, enhancing the wearer's perception as they glide through murky underwater realms or navigate through dense, foggy forests.

Reduced_Subterranean_Ocelli.description: With eyes that have atrophied from the perpetual darkness of their underground realm, these amphibious creatures rely on their highly attuned sense of Blindsight to navigate and hunt, their perception and accuracy diminished but not hindered by the absence of light.

Retractable_Ocular_Bulbs.description: Equipped with retractable ocular bulbs, this amphibian entity can hide its sensitive eyes from harsh environments or emit a hypnotic glow to lure prey, subtly enhancing its cunning nature.

Tapetum_Lucidum_Amphibiorum.description: Borrowing the eerie, luminous eyes of an amphibian, the Tapetum Lucidum Amphibiorum grants its bearer unparalleled night vision, allowing them to see through the darkest of nights with a haunting, reflective glow that enhances their perception and accuracy in the shadows.

Parietal_Third_Eye.description: Embedded deep within the amphibian's skull, this parietal third eye glows with an otherworldly luminescence, granting the creature heightened awareness and an uncanny ability to evade danger, its innate senses sharpened to near-perfect clarity.

Bifocal_Aquatic_Lenses.description: Bifocal Aquatic Lenses are crystalline orbs that shimmer with an iridescent glow, perfectly adapted for both underwater and terrestrial vision, enhancing the wearer's perception and accuracy in any environment.
